# Page header (`page-header`)

Eyebrow, title, subtitle and actions.

Group: Navigation. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/navigation';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createIconButton` (types in `dist/web/actions/iconButton.d.ts`): `.mh-icon-button`: a round, icon-only button at least a touch target wide.

```ts
export function createIconButton(options: IconButtonOptions): IconButtonHandle;

export interface IconButtonOptions {
  icon: IconName | string;
  /** Required: the button's accessible name (also its tooltip). */
  label: string;
  tone?: IconButtonTone;
  size?: IconButtonSize;
  /** A filled circle (raised surface) rather than a bare glyph. */
  filled?: boolean;
  /** Toggle buttons: sets `aria-pressed`. */
  pressed?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
}

export interface IconButtonHandle {
  el: HTMLButtonElement;
  setIcon(icon: IconName | string): void;
  setPressed(pressed: boolean): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

`createPageHeader` (types in `dist/web/navigation/pageHeader.d.ts`): `.mh-page-header`: an optional `.mh-page-header__back` button, an `<hgroup>` of `__eyebrow`, `__title` (an h1 by default) and `__subtitle`, and an `__actions` slot that wraps under the text on narrow screens.

```ts
export function createPageHeader(options: PageHeaderOptions): PageHeaderHandle;

export interface PageHeaderOptions {
  title: string;
  eyebrow?: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  /** Buttons or other controls on the trailing side. */
  actions?: Child[];
  /** A back button before the title. */
  back?: PageHeaderBack;
  /** Heading level of the title. Default 1. */
  level?: 1 | 2 | 3;
}

export interface PageHeaderHandle {
  el: HTMLElement;
  setTitle(title: string): void;
  setSubtitle(subtitle: string | null): void;
  setEyebrow(eyebrow: string | null): void;
  setActions(...actions: Child[]): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createIconButton, createPageHeader } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const allOff = createIconButton({
  icon: 'power',
  label: 'Turn off all lights',
  onClick: () => header.setSubtitle('All lights off'),
});

const header = createPageHeader({
  eyebrow: 'Ground floor',
  title: 'Living room',
  subtitle: '3 lights on',
  back: { label: 'Back to rooms', onClick: () => history.back() },
  actions: [allOff.el],
});

document.body.append(header.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { IconButton, PageHeader } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function PageHeaderExample() {
  const [lightsOn, setLightsOn] = useState(3);
  return (
    <PageHeader
      eyebrow="Ground floor"
      title="Living room"
      subtitle={lightsOn ? `${lightsOn} lights on` : 'All lights off'}
      back={{ label: 'Back to rooms', onClick: () => history.back() }}
      actions={<IconButton icon="power" label="Turn off all lights" onClick={() => setLightsOn(0)} />}
    />
  );
}
```
